reasons.m010-wrong-page: Scan leaf 127, printed page 120, ends with the start of Mrs. Kugler's entry. The Neil Senter entry is on leaf 128, printed page 121.
reasons.m010-neighbor-entry: The November 18, 1913 George U. Harn entry on leaf 128 follows the separate November 8 Neil Senter entry and concerns a different person and subject.
